verdict.rationale: Supermemory offers a single-call hybrid search that returns relevant memories/document chunks and related memories, and user profiles that are 'always ready' without a search call, which covers assembling relevant context in one call — but no docs mention a token-budget parameter or explicit prompt-sized context-block output. missing for 10: explicit token-budget/max-token control on retrieval, evidence of a single call returning a pre-formatted prompt-ready block combining profile+graph+documents together.
